title: Structural Origin of the Hale Bilinear Form: From the Viewpoint of the Green and Lagrange Identities
summary: In the study of linear retarded functional differential equations (RFDEs), the classical bilinear form proposed by J. Hale has long served as an indispensable tool for the geometric theory. Nevertheless, its original definition suffers from ambiguities, such as the non-commutativity of matrix products and the precise meaning of the involved double integrals, due to its definition motivated primarily by eigenvalue problems.
